title: Herrera attends Greer's CE5 sessions

tellings.quote: Well, I think that's what Dr. Greer's whole C5 initiative is all about which I've personally attended a few of them.

plain: Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a huge UFO in Indonesia, tells Michels he has gone to a few CE5 sessions himself. These are group gatherings run by the UFO activist Steven Greer, where people try to invite UFOs to appear, often through meditation. Herrera brings it up to explain what Greer's "whole CE5 initiative is all about": the idea that people can reach out to contact what is behind the sightings.
